goal.objective: Complete the released independent Brown-to-Berkeley acquisition forecast investment challenge within 45 elapsed minutes, 120 CPU seconds, 100 MB reads, 500 MB RSS, 100 MB storage, one process, zero ingress and the 37% actual allowance checkpoint. Independently reconstruct the paired Brown scores and materially challenge finite-law attainable gains, calibration and timing, compare the closest primary prior, assess held decision and one useful source revision against the whole remaining price, and save an auditable FUND/revision/HOLD recommendation with terminal resource and native closeout. Keep Berkeley values and all unreleased bodies sealed.
